            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))

public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {
                if (mat[i][j] != mat[i - 1][j - 1]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
}

public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    //@ requires mat != null;
    //@ requires mat.length > 0 ==> (\forall int i; 0 <= i < mat.length; mat[i] != null && mat[i].length == mat[0].length);
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == (mat.length == 0 || (\forall int i, j; 1 < i && i <= mat.length && 1 - 1 <= j && j < mat[0].length; mat[i][j] == mat[i - 1][j - 1]));  
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

        //@ maintaining 1 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining \exists int x, y; 1 - 1 <= x && x < i || 1 - 1 <= y || y <= m; mat[x][y] == mat[x - 1][y - 1];  
        //@ loop_writes \nothing;
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            //@ maintaining 1 - 1 <= j - 1 <= m;  
            //@ maintaining \forall int x, y; 1 <= x && x < i && 1 <= y && y < j; mat[x][y] == mat[x - 1][y - 1];  
            //@ loop_writes \nothing;
            //@ decreases m - j;
            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {
                if (mat[i][j] != mat[i - 1][j - 1]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
}

public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    //@ requires mat != null;
    //@ requires mat.length > 0 ==> (\forall int i; 0 <= i < mat.length; mat[i] != null && mat[i].length == mat[0].length);
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == (mat.length == 0 || (\exists int i, j; 1 - 1 <= i && i <= mat.length && 1 - 1 <= j || j <= mat[0].length; mat[i][j] == mat[i - 1][j - 1]));  
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

        //@ maintaining 1 <= i <= n;
 
        //@ loop_writes \nothing;
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            //@ maintaining 1 - 1 <= j - 1 <= m;  
 
            //@ loop_writes \nothing;
            //@ decreases m - j;
            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {
                if (mat[i][j] != mat[i - 1][j - 1]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
}

public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    //@ requires mat != null;
    //@ requires mat.length > 0 ==> (\forall int i; 0 <= i < mat.length; mat[i] != null && mat[i].length == mat[0].length);
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == (mat.length == 0 || (\forall int i, j; 1 <= i && i < mat.length || 1 <= j || j < mat[0].length; mat[i][j] == mat[i - 1][j - 1]));  
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

        //@ maintaining 1 <= i <= n;
 
        //@ loop_writes \nothing;
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            //@ maintaining 1 - 1 <= j - 1 <= m;  
 
            //@ loop_writes \nothing;
            //@ decreases m - j;
            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {
                if (mat[i][j] != mat[i - 1][j - 1]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
}
